Ankita Bhandari Case: CBI Seeks Polygraph, Narco Test for Urmila Sanwar

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has sent a notice to actress Urmila Sanwar, seeking to conduct a polygraph and narco-analysis test in connection with the Ankita Bhandari murder case. The CBI aims to uncover any "VIP angle" in the case. A Dehradun court has issued a summons to Sanwar for the tests.
